source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 8 (PDF 107-121), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 8 (Applications of Computer Science) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define emerging technologies. Name any two of them.
(Emerging technologies ki definition likhein. In mein se do ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Emerging technologies (ubharti hui technologies) nayi ya tezi se taraqqi karti technologies hain jo logon ke rehne, kaam, rabte aur masail hal karne ka tareeqa badal sakti hain. Misal: AI aur IoT (Cloud Computing aur Blockchain bhi).

book_ref.quote: Emerging technologies are new or rapidly developing technologies

blocks.prompt:
2 Name any four sectors in which emerging technologies drive innovation.
(Chaar aise shobe (sectors) likhein jin mein emerging technologies innovation la rahi hain.)
blocks.explanation: Healthcare, taleem, transportation aur zarat. In shobon mein yeh kaam tez aur behtar banati hain.

book_ref.quote: These technologies drive innovation across healthcare, education, transportation, and agriculture

blocks.prompt:
3 Give two reasons why understanding emerging technologies is important.
(Emerging technologies ko samajhna kyun zaroori hai? Do wajahein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Yeh aalmi aur maqami masail ke naye hal deti hain, is liye in ki salahiyat samajh kar mustaqbil ki tayyari hoti hai.
2. In ke saath data security, akhlaqi masail aur automation par inhisaar jaise khatre bhi hain, is liye inhein samajh kar zimmedari se istemal karna zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: By learning about these technologies, individuals can better understand their potential

blocks.prompt:
4 Define Artificial Intelligence (AI). What does it allow computers to do?
(Artificial Intelligence (AI) ki definition likhein. Yeh computers ko kya karne deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: AI computer science ki woh shaakh hai jo machines ko aise kaam karne deti hai jin ke liye aam tor par insani zehanat chahiye. Yeh computer ko data analyze karne, patterns pehchanne aur kam insani madad se faisle karne deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a branch of computer science that enables machines to perform tasks

blocks.prompt:
5 What is machine learning?
(Machine learning kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Machine learning woh amal hai jis se AI tajurbe se seekhta hai. Algorithms bade data sets par train ho kar trends pehchante aur waqt ke saath behtar hote hain; jitna zyada data, utne durust nataij.

book_ref.quote: where algorithms are trained on large sets of data to identify trends and improve performance over time

blocks.prompt:
6 Expand NN and NLP. Why does AI use them?
(NN aur NLP ka poora naam likhein. AI inhein kyun istemal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: NN = Neural Networks; NLP = Natural Language Processing. AI inhein insani dimagh ke maloomat process karne ke tareeqe ki naqal ke liye istemal karta hai, taake speech samjhe, cheezein pehchane aur nataij predict kare.

book_ref.quote: to simulate how the human brain processes information

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a voice assistant? Give two examples.
(Voice assistant kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Voice assistant aik AI application hai jo bole gaye commands samajh kar mufeed maloomat ya amal se jawab deti hai. Misal: Siri aur Alexa (Google Assistant bhi).

book_ref.quote: Voice assistants like Siri, Alexa, and Google Assistant

blocks.prompt:
8 What is a recommendation system? Name two platforms that use it.
(Recommendation system kya hai? Do platforms ke naam likhein jo ise istemal karte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Recommendation system AI se user ki pasand ke mutabiq videos ya products suggest karta hai. Platforms: YouTube aur Daraz (Amazon bhi).

book_ref.quote: AI is also used in recommendation systems on platforms like YouTube

blocks.prompt:
9 What does an image recognition system do? Give one use.
(Image recognition system kya karta hai? Aik istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Image recognition system photos aur scans se chehre, cheezein ya bimariyan pehchanta hai. Istemal: mareez ke scan se bimari pehchanna.

book_ref.quote: image recognition systems identify faces, objects, or medical conditions from photos and scans

blocks.prompt:
10 Give two examples of how AI benefits healthcare and business.
(AI healthcare aur business ko kaise faida deta hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Healthcare: DeepMind ka AI 3D eye scans dekh kar glaucoma jaisi bimari wazeh alamaat se pehle predict karne mein madad karta hai.
Business: Amazon aur Daraz AI chatbots se "Where is my order?" jaise sawalon ka hazaron users ko aik saath jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: It can perform repetitive tasks faster than humans, assist doctors in diagnosing diseases

blocks.prompt:
11 Name any three challenges of AI in society.
(Muashre mein AI ki teen mushkilat (challenges) ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Data privacy.
2. Job displacement (naukriyon ka chhin jana).
3. Algorithms mein bias jo ghair munsifana nataij de.
(Aur jab AI logon ki zindagi par asar wale faisle kare to akhlaqi masail.)

book_ref.quote: Balancing innovation with responsibility ensures that AI remains a tool that benefits humanity

blocks.prompt:
12 Define the Internet of Things (IoT). Name the parts often found in an IoT device.
(Internet of Things (IoT) ki definition likhein. IoT device mein aam tor par kaun se hisse hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: IoT internet se jure physical devices ka network hai jo data jama, share aur us par amal karte hain. In devices mein aksar sensors, processors aur communication hardware hote hain.

book_ref.quote: IoT connects everyday objects such as lights, thermostats, and appliances

blocks.prompt:
13 Give two examples of IoT in a smart home.
(Smart home mein IoT ki do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Smart LED bulbs smartphone se on/off hote hain aur sham 6:00 baje khud jalne ke liye set hote hain.
2. Smart parde subah ke alarm par khud khulte aur 35 degree Celsius se zyada hararat par band hote hain.
(Smart thermostat aur security cameras bhi jo smartphone par alert bhejte hain.)

book_ref.quote: smart curtains or blinds can open automatically with the morning alarm

blocks.prompt:
14 How is IoT used in healthcare?
(Healthcare mein IoT kaise istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: IoT sensors dil ki dhadkan, blood pressure ya glucose real time mein dekhte hain. Is se doctor door se mareez ki sehat dekh kar emergency mein jaldi madad kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: This allows doctors to track patient health remotely and respond quickly in emergencies.

blocks.prompt:
15 What is automation in IoT? Give an example.
(IoT mein automation kya hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Automation ka matlab hai analyze shuda data khud ba khud koi amal shuru kar de, haath ke control ki zaroorat kam ho. Misal: kamre mein koi na ho to lights band, ya mitti khushk ho to aabpashi shuru.

book_ref.quote: The analyzed data can trigger specific actions automatically

blocks.prompt:
16 What is the role of sensors in IoT? Name two things they measure.
(IoT mein sensors ka kya kirdar hai? Do cheezein batayein jo yeh naapte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Sensors mahol se data jama karte hain jo phir cloud systems ya servers ko processing ke liye jata hai. Yeh misal ke tor par temperature aur nami (humidity) naapte hain (harkat bhi).

book_ref.quote: IoT creates smarter, safer, and more efficient environments for homes, industries, and communities

blocks.prompt:
17 Define cloud computing. Who manages the servers used in it?
(Cloud computing ki definition likhein. Is ke servers kaun manage karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cloud computing woh technology hai jo users ko data local computer ke bajaye remote servers par store, manage aur process karne deti hai. Yeh servers internet par hote hain aur cloud service providers inhein manage karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Cloud computing is a technology that allows users to store, manage, and process data on remote servers

blocks.prompt:
18 Name any three online services or tools that cloud computing supports.
(Cloud computing ki support wali teen online services ya tools ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Data storage aur web hosting.
2. Streaming platforms.
3. Online learning systems (software applications aur collaborative workspaces bhi).

book_ref.quote: This technology forms the backbone of many services people use daily

blocks.prompt:
19 What is meant by scalability in cloud computing?
(Cloud computing mein scalability se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scalability ka matlab hai user zaroorat ke mutabiq storage aur computing power ko asani se barha ya ghata sake. Yeh barhte karobar ke liye behtareen hai.

book_ref.quote: which is ideal for growing businesses and organizations

blocks.prompt:
20 What is the pay-as-you-go model?
(Pay-as-you-go model kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pay-as-you-go model mein cloud user sirf istemal ki gayi services ka paisa deta hai. Mehenge servers aur staff ki zaroorat bhi kam hoti hai, is liye kharcha ghatta hai.

book_ref.quote: which helps lower operational costs

blocks.prompt:
21 What is AWS? Name two of its services.
(AWS kya hai? Is ki do services ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: AWS (Amazon Web Services) aik cloud platform hai jo duniya bhar ke karobar istemal karte hain. Yeh web hosting aur data storage (aur application development) deta hai.

book_ref.quote: widely used by businesses around the world

blocks.prompt:
22 Define blockchain. What is a block?
(Blockchain ki definition likhein. Block kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blockchain aik digital nizam hai jo maloomat aik markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par mehfooz tareeqe se rakhta aur share karta hai. Block aik tasdeeq shuda record hai; har block pichhle se jur kar na badalne wali chain banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Blockchain technology is a digital system that securely stores and shares information

blocks.prompt:
23 Give two non-financial uses of blockchain.
(Blockchain ke do ghair maali (non-financial) istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Supply chain: maal ko shuru se customer tak track kar ke asliyat yaqeeni banata hai.
2. Data security: legal documents, medical files aur certificates ka tamper-proof storage (hukoomat aur school zameen ke records aur taleemi asnaad ke liye bhi).

book_ref.quote: In supply chain management, it tracks goods from origin to customer, ensuring authenticity.

blocks.prompt:
24 What is meant by the decentralized structure of blockchain?
(Blockchain ke decentralized (ghair markazi) dhanche se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Decentralized ka matlab hai data aik markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par, har aik ke paas copy. Yeh banks ya hukoomat jaise darmiyani idaron ko hata kar seedha, durust aur jawabdeh len-den karata hai.

book_ref.quote: It allows direct, accurate, and accountable exchanges between individuals and organizations.

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between cloud computing and blockchain.
(Cloud computing aur blockchain mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono technologies maqsad aur dhanche mein mukhtalif hain, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: most of the processing is done remotely

rows: Data remote servers par store, manage aur process hota hai.
Records aik markazi server ke bajaye bohat se computers par hote hain.
Servers cloud service providers manage karte hain.
Decentralized; banks ya hukoomat jaise intermediaries nahin.
Khoobiyan: scalability, accessibility, kam kharcha.
Khoobiyan: shaffafiyat, security aur aitbaar (tamper-proof records).
Misal: Google Drive, AWS, Microsoft Azure.
Misal: Bitcoin, zameen ke records, supply chain tracking.

blocks.text: 8.2 Cultural and Ethical Implications of AI Systems

blocks.prompt:
26 Why should the cultural and ethical effects of AI be considered?
(AI ke saqafati aur akhlaqi asraat ko kyun dekhna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: AI logon ke rehne, kaam aur technology se taluq par asar dalta hai. AI sirf technical cheez nahin balke samaji auzaar bhi hai jo afraad, communities aur hukoomaton par asar dalta hai.

book_ref.quote: making it essential to consider its cultural and ethical effects

blocks.prompt:
27 Name the four stakeholders of AI systems.
(AI systems ke chaar stakeholders ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Developers, jo AI models banate hain.
2. Users, jo istemal karte hain.
3. Hukoomat, jo regulate karti hai.
4. Communities, jo asar mehsoos karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Each group contributes to the overall ecosystem of AI and influences how it evolves.

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between developers and users as stakeholders of AI.
(AI ke stakeholders ke tor par developers aur users mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ke kirdar aur fikrein mukhtalif hain, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: They ensure systems are accurate, fair, and ethically developed.

rows: AI systems design aur tayyar karte hain.
Rozana kaamon mein AI istemal karte hain.
Functionality, innovation aur performance par tawajjuh.
Chahte hain ke system aasan aur qabil-e-aitbaar ho.
Yaqeeni banate hain ke system durust, munsif aur akhlaqi ho.
Privacy, security aur durust nataij ki fikr karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
29 What is the role of communities as stakeholders of AI?
(AI ke stakeholder ke tor par communities ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Communities AI ka asar mehsoos karti hain. Woh samaji aqdaar aur saqafati usool bachane par tawajjuh deti aur muashre mein AI ke zimmedar aur akhlaqi istemal ko farogh deti hain.

book_ref.quote: They promote responsible and ethical use of AI in society.

blocks.prompt:
30 Why do conflicts arise among stakeholders? Give one example.
(Stakeholders mein conflict kyun hota hai? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Conflict tab hota hai jab stakeholders ki tarjeehat takrayein. Misal: businesses munafe ke liye data jama karna chahte hain jabke users privacy aur apni maloomat par ikhtiyar chahte hain.

book_ref.quote: Conflicts often arise when stakeholders have competing priorities.

blocks.prompt:
31 How can a fair balance be achieved in data collection between companies and users?
(Companiyon aur users ke darmiyan data jama karne mein munasib tawazun kaise hasil ho?)
blocks.explanation: Companiyan AI behtar karne ke liye data jama karti hain, magar baghair wazeh ijazat yeh privacy aur aitbaar todta hai. Shaffaf data policies aur aasan consent ke tareeqe tawazun qaim karte hain.

book_ref.quote: A common example of conflict is data collection practices.

blocks.prompt:
32 Why must AI designers consider local traditions and behaviours?
(AI designers ko maqami riwayaat aur rawaiyon ka khayal kyun rakhna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Saqafati aqdaar privacy, guftagu ke andaz aur technology apnane ki tawaqqoaat par asar dalti hain. Maqami riwayaat ka khayal AI tools ko qabil-e-rasai aur har saqafat ke liye ba-ehtiraam banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Designers must consider local traditions and behaviors to make AI tools accessible

blocks.prompt:
33 Give two ways in which AI design can respect cultural diversity.
(AI design saqafati tanawwu (diversity) ka ehtiraam kaise kar sakta hai? Do tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Language models mein mukhtalif zabanein aur lehje shamil hon taake ghalib saqafaton ki taraf jhukao na ho.
2. AI ke faisle maqami riwayaat aur samaji usoolon ka lehaz rakhein (aur ilaqai privacy pasand ka bhi).

book_ref.quote: AI-driven decisions should reflect sensitivity to local customs and social norms

blocks.prompt:
34 Name the four ethical principles of AI systems and the purpose of each.
(AI systems ke chaar akhlaqi usool aur har aik ka maqsad likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Fairness (insaf): imtiyaz (discrimination) rokna.
2. Accountability (jawabdehi): zimmedari tay karna.
3. Transparency (shaffafiyat): batana ke system faisle kaise karta hai.
4. Safety (hifazat): users ko nuqsan se bachana.

book_ref.quote: These principles ensure that AI remains a tool for human benefit

blocks.prompt:
35 Using the example of AI in student admission, explain transparency and accountability.
(Admission mein AI ki misal se transparency aur accountability samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Transparency: university ko bata sakna chahiye ke talib-e-ilm kyun select ya rad hua.
Accountability: wazeh ho ke agar system ghair munsifana faisla kare to zimmedar kaun hai.

book_ref.quote: The university must also be able to explain why a student was selected or rejected

blocks.prompt:
36 What is inclusivity in AI design?
(AI design mein inclusivity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: AI design mein inclusivity ka matlab hai mukhtalif nuqta-e-nazar ko shamil karna aur yaqeeni banana ke technology gender, nasl ya pas-e-manzar se qata-e-nazar sab ki barabar khidmat kare.

book_ref.quote: Inclusivity in AI design means considering diverse perspectives

blocks.prompt:
37 How can a face recognition system become biased? How can developers avoid it?
(Face recognition system biased kaise ho sakta hai? Developers is se kaise bachein?)
blocks.explanation: Agar woh zyada tar aik umar, rang ya ilaqe ki tasveeron par train ho to doosre groups ke liye bura kaam karta hai. Developers ko dataset ka jaiza le kar use durust karna chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, if a face recognition system is trained mainly on images of one age group

blocks.prompt:
38 Define bias in AI. Give one cause.
(AI mein bias ki definition likhein. Aik wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: AI mein bias tab hota hai jab system biased data, kamzor design ya groups ki ghair barabar numaindagi ki wajah se ghair munsifana nataij de. Wajah: biased training data, maslan purane hiring records jin mein mard zyada select hue.

book_ref.quote: Bias in AI occurs when an AI system gives unfair results because of biased data

blocks.prompt:
39 What is GDPR? What does it enforce?
(GDPR kya hai? Yeh kya lagu karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) European Union ka framework hai. Yeh data privacy aur user ke huqooq ke sakht qawaid lagu karta hai.

book_ref.quote: These frameworks encourage nations and companies to adopt responsible AI practices.

blocks.prompt:
40 Give two things a national AI policy can do for Pakistan.
(Qaumi AI policy Pakistan ke liye kya kar sakti hai? Do baatein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Data protection ko regulate karna aur research ki hosla afzai.
2. Maqami aqdaar aur zaroorat ke mutabiq AI hal ki madad (awam ka aitbaar aur aalmi shirakat).

book_ref.quote: Such policies can regulate data protection, encourage research

blocks.text: 8.3 Designing Applications for Pakistan Using Emerging Technologies

blocks.prompt:
41 Name four sectors of Pakistan that emerging technologies can transform when used responsibly.
(Pakistan ke chaar shobe likhein jinhein emerging technologies zimmedari se istemal ho kar badal sakti hain.)
blocks.explanation: Healthcare, taleem, zarat aur governance.

book_ref.quote: These technologies can transform sectors like healthcare, education, agriculture, and governance

blocks.prompt:
42 State the national challenge of Pakistan in education and in governance.
(Pakistan ka taleem aur governance mein qaumi challenge likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Taleem ko meyar aur rasai (outreach) mein rukawatein darpesh hain. Governance ko shaffafiyat aur efficiency chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Pakistan faces several national challenges that can be addressed through technology.

blocks.prompt:
43 Name any three major challenges of Pakistan that technology can help address, according to the chapter.
(Chapter ke mutabiq Pakistan ke teen bade masail likhein jin mein technology madad kar sakti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Pani ki kami, taleem tak mehdood rasai aur sehat ki sahooliyat pohanchana.

book_ref.quote: Technology can help address major challenges in Pakistan, such as water shortages

blocks.prompt:
44 Match one application to each emerging technology as suggested in the chapter: AI, IoT, Cloud, Blockchain.
(Chapter ke mutabiq har technology ke saath aik application likhein: AI, IoT, Cloud, Blockchain.)
blocks.explanation:
AI: intelligent tutoring systems.
IoT: smart city management.
Cloud: mehfooz data rasai.
Blockchain: record ki tasdeeq (authentication).

book_ref.quote: AI can be used for intelligent tutoring systems

blocks.prompt:
45 Name three local issues that student projects can address, and one benefit of such projects.
(Talaba ke projects kin teen maqami masail ko hal kar sakte hain? Aik faida bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pani ka intezam, traffic control aur taleem tak rasai. Aise projects tanqeedi soch (critical thinking) barhate aur community ki taraqqi mein hissa dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Projects that address issues such as water management, traffic control, or education accessibility

blocks.prompt:
46 Why is integrating more than one emerging technology useful?
(Aik se zyada emerging technologies ko mila kar istemal karna kyun mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: AI ki zehanat, IoT ka rabta, Cloud ki scalability aur Blockchain ki security mil kar taqatwar data par mabni systems banate hain jo masle hal karne ke saath waqt ke saath behtar bhi hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Effective solutions often integrate more than one emerging technology.

blocks.prompt:
47 Name the technologies used in a smart irrigation system and the job of each.
(Smart irrigation system mein kaun si technologies hain aur har aik ka kaam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: IoT sensors mitti ki nami naapte hain; AI algorithms faslon ki pani ki zaroorat predict karte hain; Cloud storage data jama aur analyze karta hai. Is se pani bachta, kharcha kam aur paidawar zyada hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: This helps farmers optimize water use, reduce costs, and increase yields.

blocks.prompt:
48 What should students keep in mind about Pakistan's culture while designing applications?
(Applications banate waqt talaba ko Pakistan ki saqafat ke bare mein kya yaad rakhna chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Pakistan mein mukhtalif saqafatein aur riwayaat hain, is liye applications inclusive, qabil-e-rasai aur maqami riwayaat ka ehtiraam karne wali hon. AI ki zaban aur mawad ilaqai tanawwu aur samaji hassasiyat ko zahir kare.

book_ref.quote: AI systems should use language and content that reflect regional diversity and social sensitivities.

blocks.prompt:
49 How does AI-based weather prediction help farmers?
(AI se mausam ki peshgoi kisaanon ki kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: AI mausam ka data analyze kar ke barish, khushk sali ya hararat ke patterns predict karta hai. Kisaan in se apne kaam plan kar ke faslon ko mausmi nuqsan se bachate hain; paidawar barhti aur nuqsan kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: leading to better yields and reduced losses

blocks.prompt:
50 What data do IoT soil sensors collect, and how does it help farmers?
(IoT soil sensors kya data jama karte hain aur is se kisaanon ko kya faida hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh mitti ki nami, hararat aur nutrients ka real time data jama karte hain. Is se kisaan data par mabni faisle karte hain, jaise kab aur kitna pani dena hai; kaam behtar aur wasail mehfooz hote hain.

book_ref.quote: improving efficiency and conserving resources

blocks.prompt:
51 In smart agriculture, differentiate between the role of cloud computing and blockchain.
(Smart agriculture mein cloud computing aur blockchain ke kirdar mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Zarai nizam mein dono ka kaam alag hai, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Together, these technologies create a sustainable and trustworthy agricultural ecosystem

rows: Zarai data ka scalable storage deta hai.
Fasal ki paidawar aur taqseem ka har marhala record karta hai.
Kisaanon, mohaqqiqeen aur policy makers ko jaldi rasai deta hai.
Supply chain mein shaffafiyat lata hai.
Maloomat ko behtar tareeqe se rakhta aur share karta hai.
Dhoka kam aur munsifana tijarat yaqeeni banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
52 Why are clear policies and responsible innovation practices essential for emerging technologies?
(Emerging technologies ke liye wazeh policies aur zimmedarana innovation kyun zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jaise jaise technologies aage barhti hain, wazeh policies aur zimmedarana innovation in ka mehfooz aur akhlaqi istemal yaqeeni banati hain. Qanoon, governance frameworks aur ishtirak taraqqi aur jawabdehi mein tawazun rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: students can learn to design solutions that uphold fairness, inclusivity, and contribute to social good

blocks.prompt:
53 Give one global and one national example of AI governance.
(AI governance ki aik aalmi aur aik qaumi misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Aalmi: Europe ka GDPR data protection aur privacy ke meyar tay karta hai (aalmi AI ethics guidelines bhi shaffafiyat aur insaf barhati hain). Qaumi: mumalik zimmedarana innovation ke liye apni AI strategies bana rahe hain.

book_ref.quote: International AI ethics guidelines also promote transparency and fairness in automated decision-making.

blocks.prompt:
54 Name four aspects of human life that emerging technologies affect.
(Insani zindagi ke chaar pehlu likhein jin par emerging technologies asar dalti hain.)
blocks.explanation: Privacy, rozgar (employment), faisla sazi aur security.

book_ref.quote: from privacy and employment to decision-making and security

blocks.prompt:
55 What is interdisciplinary collaboration? Name the role of legal experts in it.
(Interdisciplinary collaboration kya hai? Is mein legal experts ka kirdar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Interdisciplinary collaboration (mukhtalif shobon ka ishtirak) ka matlab hai mukhtalif shobon ke mahireen mil kar zimmedar aur munsif technology banayein. Legal experts qanoon ki pabandi yaqeeni banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Building responsible and fair technology requires collaboration among professionals from various fields.

blocks.prompt:
56 Differentiate between the roles of sociologists and ethicists in technology development.
(Technology ki tayyari mein sociologists aur ethicists ke kirdar mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mutawazin hal banane mein madad karte hain magar un ki tawajjuh alag hai, table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Interdisciplinary collaboration ensures that innovation remains inclusive, fair, and sustainable

rows: Technology ke samaji asar ka mutala karte hain.
Akhlaqi faislon ki rehnumai karte hain.
Legal experts aur ethicists ke saath mil kar mutawazin hal banate hain.
Legal experts aur sociologists ke saath mil kar mutawazin hal banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
57 Define responsible innovation. Give two aims of technology developed responsibly.
(Responsible innovation ki definition likhein. Zimmedari se banayi technology ke do maqasid likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Responsible innovation ka matlab hai sirf maali faide ke bajaye insani bhalai par tawajjuh. Maqasid: zindagi ka meyar behtar karna aur mauqe paida karna (aur nuqsan kam karna).

book_ref.quote: Technologies should be developed to improve quality of life, create opportunities, and minimize harm.
